scope: Source-level review of the exact Iconbox single/double-click route after R38; no product code, tests, installed files, or live windows changed.

finding.path: DomainOSIconbox.doubleClickRecord -> checkTarget -> controller.resolveWindow; a singleton is then resolved again immediately before checking active/minimized state.
finding.potential_issue: The second resolveWindow(...).record access has no explicit null guard.
finding.event_order: Both resolutions happen synchronously in one JavaScript handler. The handler does not call processEvents, await, or Qt.callLater between them; Qt model refresh signals are processed on the owning event loop. A queued target removal therefore cannot ordinarily interleave between these reads.
finding.assessment: This unchecked read is a narrow defensive-hardening candidate, but current control flow does not make it a supported explanation for the reported intermittent freeze or plasmashell restart. A speculative edit would not be evidence-based.

result: No source defect tied to the reported restart was established. Keep current R37 native click evidence and R38 runtime audit scoped as documented; no code change is justified until a reproducible sequence or correlated crash evidence appears.
next: If the behavior recurs, correlate the exact lsi plasmashell PID/time and journal/coredump; then reproduce only with test-owned clients. P04 remains open and authorized.
